question: The Badminton World Federation (BWF) has upgraded India Open from Super 500 level to Super 750 level for the next _________ years.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**five**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **India Open** is a prestigious badminton tournament hosted annually in India.
 
• The **Badminton World Federation (BWF)** is the international governing body for the sport of badminton.
 
• The BWF has upgraded the India Open tournament from the **Super 500 level** to the **Super 750 level**, a significant development in the badminton world.
 
• This upgrade will be applicable for the next **five years**, which means the tournament will hold the Super 750 status until 2027.
 
• Super 750 tournaments are part of the **BWF World Tour**, which is a series of elite badminton events featuring top players globally.
 
• The promotion to Super 750 level signifies the growing prominence of Indian badminton on the **international stage**.
 
• Higher-level tournaments like Super 750 attract more **world-class players**, offer larger prize money, and enhance the visibility of the sport in the host country.
 
• This decision reflects the **efforts of the Badminton Association of India** (BAI) in organizing and promoting the sport effectively.
 
• India Open's elevation is expected to further boost the popularity of badminton in India and encourage participation at the **grassroots level**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Badminton World Federation (BWF)**

 
 
• The BWF was established in **1934** and is headquartered in **Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia**.
 
• It governs international badminton competitions, including the **BWF World Tour, Thomas Cup, Uber Cup, and World Championships.**
 
• It categorizes tournaments into different levels such as **Super 1000, Super 750, Super 500, and Super 300**, based on their prestige and prize money.
 
 
 
• **India Open**
 
 
• The India Open was first held in **2008** and has grown in stature over the years.
 
• It is organized by the **Badminton Association of India (BAI)**, which was established in **1934** to oversee the development of badminton in India.
 
 
 
• **BWF World Tour Structure**
 
 
• The BWF World Tour is divided into six levels: **World Tour Finals, Super 1000, Super 750, Super 500, Super 300, and Super 100.**
 
• It was introduced in **2018** to replace the earlier Superseries format.
 
• Higher-level tournaments like Super 750 offer more **ranking points** and prize money, making them highly competitive.
